nodes.label: MaxProof: Scaling Mathematical Proof with Generative-Verifier RL and Population-Level Test-Time Scaling
nodes.author: Jiacheng Chen et al.
nodes.rationale: Addresses competition-level mathematical proof through three atomic capabilities (generation, verification, repair) merged into M3 model, then scaled via population-level test-time search.

nodes.label: Proof Expert: Long-Horizon RL under Defense-in-Depth Verifier
nodes.rationale: Trained via CISPO RL with four-layer generative verifier (bad-case filtering, solution normalization, multi-judge scoring, pessimistic aggregation) to suppress reward hacking patterns.

nodes.label: Verifier Expert: Aligned Error Finding
nodes.rationale: Distills verifier behavior into single M3 model via error-finding task formulation; trained on harvested data from Proof Expert's RL run to ensure alignment on same notion of correctness.

nodes.label: Fixer Expert: Proof Repair by Rejection-Sampling Fine-Tune
nodes.rationale: Learns to repair flawed proofs given critique; trained via rejection sampling on Proof Expert's RL byproducts, accepting only repairs verified as fully correct.

nodes.label: MaxProof: Population-Level Test-Time Scaling Framework
nodes.rationale: Model-agnostic framework converting best@K into pass@1 via population search, conservative fitness, diverse parent selection, dual PATCH/REWRITE refinement, and pairwise tournament selection.

nodes.label: Four-Layer Defense-in-Depth Verifier Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Engineered to minimize false positives during long-horizon RL: Layer 1 (bad-case filtering), Layer 2 (solution normalization), Layer 3 (multi-judge scoring), Layer 4 (pessimistic min aggregation).

nodes.label: M2 Cycle Reward-Hacking Case Study
nodes.rationale: Documents four canonical hacking patterns (length bias, format hacking, semantic shortcut, judge-specific preference) that motivated M3 verifier design.

nodes.label: IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026 Results
nodes.rationale: M3 + MaxProof achieves 35/42 on IMO 2025 and 36/42 on USAMO 2026, exceeding human gold-medal threshold; demonstrates +8 and +10 point gains from test-time scaling.

nodes.label: CISPO: Off-Policy RL Algorithm for Proof Generation
nodes.rationale: Clips importance-sampling weight rather than surrogate loss; preserves token-level gradients in long responses; uses group-level std-threshold filter to suppress noisy group-relative advantages.

nodes.label: Per-Problem Search Dynamics and Selection Loss
nodes.rationale: Oracle-best vs. self-pick analysis reveals population ceiling and selection mechanism quality; USAMO 2026 P2 shows 4-point selection loss when ranker disagrees with verifier scores.

edges.rationale: Both employ long reasoning chains, inference-time scaling, and RL-driven cognition for complex problem-solving.

hyperedges.label: MaxProof Three-Expert System for Mathematical Proof
hyperedges.rationale: Three complementary atomic capabilities (generation, verification, repair) merged into single M3 model; share common notion of correctness via pessimistic-min verifier.
